title: Every FIFA Best Men's Player winner, by age
sources: data/ballondor/players.json (dates of birth for Ronaldo, Messi, Modric, Dembele, from ballondor.com)
checked: Winners 2016-2025 and the 2025 top three (Dembele, Yamal, Mbappe) from Wikipedia, SI and ESPN. Ages at the award (end of year): Ronaldo 31, 32 (born Feb 1985); Modric 33 (Sep 1985); Messi 32, 35, 36 (June 1987); Lewandowski 32, 33 (Aug 1988); Vinicius 24 (July 2000); Dembele 28 (May 1997); Haaland 23 in Jan 2024 (July 2000); Yamal 18 in Dec 2025 (July 2007). 2023: Messi and Haaland level on 48 points, Messi won on the most first places from national team captains (ESPN, CBS, The Week). 2024: Vinicius beat Rodri, who had won the Ballon d'Or on 28 Oct (90min, Goal); FIFA ceremony 17 Dec = seven weeks. 2020 Ballon d'Or not held (ballondor.com rankings, Wikipedia). Messi scored twice in the 2022 final, the first a 23rd-minute penalty (Wikipedia, FIFA). Croatia reached the 2018 final.

lines.text: FIFA's vote for the world's best player once ended in a dead heat. One man was thirty-six. The other was twenty-three.
lines.say: Feefa's vote for the world's best player once ended in a dead heat. One man was thirty-six. The other was twenty-three.

lines.text: The award began in twenty sixteen. Cristiano Ronaldo won the first two, at thirty-one and thirty-two.
lines.say: The award began in twenty sixteen. Kristeeahnoh Ronaldo won the first two, at thirty-one and thirty-two.

lines.text: Then Luka Modrić, at thirty-three, after taking Croatia to a World Cup final.
lines.say: Then Looka Modritch, at thirty-three, after taking Kroayshuh to a World Cup final.

lines.text: Lewandowski won it twice, at thirty-two and thirty-three. In twenty twenty, there wasn't even a Ballon d'Or.
lines.say: Lehvandoffskee won it twice, at thirty-two and thirty-three. In twenty twenty, there wasn't even a Balon Dor.

lines.text: Messi won it at thirty-five, after the World Cup in Qatar. He scored twice in the final.
lines.say: Messee won it at thirty-five, after the World Cup in Kattar. He scored twice in the final.

lines.text: Twenty twenty-three. Messi was thirty-six, playing in Miami. Haaland was twenty-three, with a treble and fifty-two goals.
lines.say: Twenty twenty-three. Messee was thirty-six, playing in Miami. Hohland was twenty-three, with a treble and fifty-two goals.

lines.text: The votes came in. Forty-eight points each. A dead heat.
lines.say: The votes came in. Forty-eight points each. A dead heat.

lines.text: The tie-break was the national team captains. More of them put Messi first. He won it for a third time.
lines.say: The tie-break was the national team captains. More of them put Messee first. He won it for a third time.

scene.headline: Messi beats Haaland on a tie-break
scene.standfirst: Level on 48 points, Messi takes FIFA's award with more first-place votes from national team captains.

lines.text: Twenty twenty-four. Vinícius Júnior lost the Ballon d'Or to Rodri. Seven weeks later, FIFA crowned him, at twenty-four.
lines.say: Twenty twenty-four. Vineeseeus Zhooneeor lost the Balon Dor to Rodree. Seven weeks later, Feefa crowned him, at twenty-four.

lines.text: Last December, Ousmane Dembélé made it a Paris double, at twenty-eight.
lines.say: Last December, Oosmahn Dembehlay made it a Paree double, at twenty-eight.

lines.text: Line them all up, and eight of the ten winners were thirty-one or older.
lines.say: Line them all up, and eight of the ten winners were thirty-one or older.

lines.text: But look who came second last year. Lamine Yamal. Eighteen years old.
lines.say: But look who came second last year. Lahmeen Yahmahl. Eighteen years old.

lines.text: The youngest winner is still twenty-four. Yamal could beat that by years.
lines.say: The youngest winner is still twenty-four. Yahmahl could beat that by years.
